tested_condition: The global design system is sufficiently materialized to support Phase 3 page composition.
expected_outcome: Reusable global styles, component primitives, responsive behavior, and accessibility foundations are ready without final route materialization.
actual_outcome: Authority-derived tokens, shell patterns, typography hierarchy, spacing rhythm, card treatments, and CTA primitives are implemented and consumed by placeholders. Validation commands could not execute because the shell lacks npm/node, but file-level readiness for Phase 3 is in place.
passes: Global style tokens are active in app/globals.css.
Layout primitives exist for shell, page intro, evidence block, card, and CTA composition.
Typography and spacing systems reflect authority intent.
Mobile-first behavior and reduced-motion handling are implemented.
